observations: The page number «XXI» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «IV» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line.

The words of the notes of O are printed in italics as they stand in the manuscript, each followed by a point; the readings proposed for them in italics with the dots under ḥ, ḳ, ṣ, ṭ, the macrons and the ʿayn as a raised reversed comma (L29, L38). L15 «vveli» and L26 «kavvekib» have two italic v's, where «wanuczeni» (L15) has the italic w. L28 «Kullu’l-» and L37-L38 «unshi’a»: the apostrophe after the i stands beside the dot of the i.

critical_notes.evidence: «unter einem bestimmen Stichwort», under a particular headword: the participle is «bestimmten»; the t has dropped out
«der griechiche Hermes», the Greek Hermes: the adjective is «griechische»; the s before ch has dropped out
